lead: Movable furniture and storage for the home, organised by what it does (seating, tables, beds, storage, organisers); mainstream pieces are trimmed to market-covering ranges and test winners, while design classics follow designer archetype → licensed maker/vintage/replica, and craft and period furniture is linked to the traditions register.

depts.note: Tier for everyday upholstery; variety for design classics (licensed original, vintage, replica).

b.v: kiln-dried hardwood, corner-blocked, dowelled or jointed > stapled softwood or particleboard
b.w: Sofas and armchairs are judged from the inside out, frame first.

b.v: eight-way hand-tied springs > sinuous springs > webbing
b.w: The spring system comes after the frame.

b.v: high-density foam, 1.8 lb per cubic foot or more
b.w: Foam density sets how the seat holds up.

b.v: 100,000+ severe contract > 40,000+ contract > 25,000-40,000 heavy domestic > 15,000-25,000 general domestic > 10,000-15,000 light domestic > under 10,000 decorative
b.w: The rub count rates the cover for its use.

b.v: 5-10 years
b.w: A long frame warranty backs the construction.

b.v: licensed original > authorised vintage > unlicensed replica
b.w: Collectors judge a classic by maker and licence holder, then designer and period.

s.brief: Trim IKEA to 3-4 market-covering ranges plus other mass-market leaders and test winners. Archetypes: Chesterfield (deep-buttoned, rolled arms), Togo (Ligne Roset, Michel Ducaroy), Camaleonda (B&B Italia), Marenco, Soriana, Cardigan, Confidential; Lawson, camelback, tuxedo, Knole as types or archetypes. Majlis floor seating as Gulf/Arab tradition (traditions register entry). Futon sofa: restraint.

k.brief: Types: loveseat, settee, Lawson, camelback, tuxedo, Knole.
New kind; archetype with origin and leading makers.
Togo and Camaleonda as archetypes; modular sofas as type.
New kind: low floor cushions and bolsters round a room; tradition entry.

s.brief: Split the old flat armchair list into archetypes with licensed makers, vintage and replica versions: Eames Lounge Chair & Ottoman (Herman Miller/Vitra), Barcelona (Knoll), Wassily (Knoll), Egg, Swan (Fritz Hansen), Womb (Knoll), LC2/LC3 (Cassina), Paimio (Artek), Red and Blue (Cassina), Ball, Tongue, Ribbon, Coconut, Diamond, Platner, Safari, Wegner (Papa Bear, CH25, Shell), Poäng as mass-market icon. Lounge chair is a new kind distinct from the upholstered armchair. Wingback (Queen Anne, Strandmon), club chair (Art Deco fauteuil club) as new kinds. LC4 chaise longue (Cassina), Récamier and méridienne on chaise longue. Morris chair (Arts & Crafts) under recliner or armchair. Rocking chair: Thonet No.1, Eames RAR, Windsor/Shaker rockers. Bean bag: Sacco (Zanotta), Fatboy. Ottoman: Pouf, Moroccan leather pouffe.

k.brief: New kind for design-classic easy chairs; take archetypes out of k5.
Bubble Chair (Eero Aarnio) and rattan egg as archetypes.
Types: footstool, pouffe, storage ottoman.

s.brief: Restraint for loungers and hammocks (trim to market-covering brands); add the Adirondack chair as the icon of garden seating.

k.brief: Types: rope, fabric, Brazilian, Mayan, hammock with stand.

depts.note: Desk chairs are tier (independent tests); dining chairs are variety at the design-classic end.

b.v: steam-bent or jointed solid wood, welded steel > glued and stapled
b.w: Chairs fail at the joints first.

b.v: seat height, depth, lumbar, armrests, tilt tension
b.w: Fit to the sitter is what independent tests measure.

b.v: licensed original > authorised vintage > unlicensed replica
b.w: Collectors judge a classic by maker and licence holder.

s.brief: Archetypes with licensed makers and versions: Thonet No. 14, Wishbone CH24 (Carl Hansen), Series 7 and Ant (Fritz Hansen, Arne Jacobsen), Panton (Vitra), Tulip chair (Knoll, Saarinen), Eames Plastic/DSW, Cesca and Wassily-era tubular, Bertoia, Superleggera, Zig-Zag (Rietveld), Tolix A, Navy (Emeco), Louis Ghost, Chiavari, ladder-back. Windsor chair is a new kind (comb-back, bow-back, hoop-back; British and American Windsor tradition). Shaker chairs as tradition entry. Folding: Plia, Tripolina, director's chair. Bar stools: trim IKEA; add icons (Tam Tam is a stool; Bombo; Hee). Bench: trim IKEA, Nakashima-type slab benches if sourced. Floor chair: zaisu (Japan); Korean/Japanese floor seating link.

k.brief: Director's chair as type or archetype.
New kind: low stools (Aalto Stool 60, Butterfly stool by Sori Yanagi, milking stool).
Zaisu; floor cushions belong in Soft Furnishings.

s.brief: Tier: market-covering makers plus independent test winners (Wirecutter, RTINGS, Which?). Archetypes for the icons: Aeron, Embody, Leap and Gesture (Steelcase), HÅG Capisco, Vertebra, Eames Aluminum Group, Markus as mass-market. Gaming chairs: racing-seat style; add test winners (Secretlab etc. only if sourced).

depts.note: Tier for everyday tables; variety for design classics, writing furniture and period/craft pieces.

b.v: solid wood > veneer on plywood > veneer on particleboard or MDF
b.w: Cabinets and tables are judged by the main material first.

b.v: dovetail > dowel or mortise > cam-lock or staple
b.w: Joints come after material.

b.v: no wobble
b.w: A test you can do in the shop.

b.v: licensed original or documented antique > reproduction
b.w: Collectors judge by maker, designer and period.

s.brief: Archetypes: Tulip table (Saarinen/Knoll), refectory and trestle tables, drop-leaf and extending tables as types, Ming/Qing hardwood (huanghuali, zitan) tables with a Chinese hardwood furniture tradition entry, Shaker trestle, Nakashima. Gateleg: Norden and Vihals as mass-market; Jacobean gateleg as period form. Bar table and kitchen island: restraint.

k.brief: Types: drop-leaf, extending, pedestal, trestle, refectory.
Freestanding only; fitted islands are Home Fixtures.

s.brief: Archetypes: Noguchi coffee table (Herman Miller/Vitra), Eames LTR, Platner, Saarinen side table, Isamu Noguchi Akari not here, Lack as mass-market icon, nesting tables. Damascene (Syrian) mother-of-pearl inlay, Moroccan brass and thuya tray tables, Kashmiri walnut carving and Jepara teak carving as tradition entries tied to side and tray tables. Tea trolley Aalto 901 and Møller trolley as bar-cart archetypes. Kotatsu: Japanese heated table. Game table: card and games tables, Georgian fold-over.

k.brief: Types: end table, nesting tables, pedestal table.
Moroccan and Damascene tray tables.
Restraint: Råskog as mass-market icon.

s.brief: New kinds from findings: writing bureau (slant-front), secretaire (secrétaire à abattant, fall-front), davenport (small sloped desk with side drawers); also pedestal/partners desk and roll-top as desk types. Shaker and Arts & Crafts/Mission desks as archetypes if sourced. Sit-stand desk: tier (test winners). Dressing table: trim IKEA, add vanity/poudreuse. Drafting table and lap desk: restraint.

k.brief: Types: pedestal, partners, roll-top, writing desk, computer desk.

depts.note: Mattresses are tier (independent tests); beds are tier with craft and period forms.

b.v: innerspring; foam; hybrid; latex; airbed (a choice, not a ranking)
b.w: Mattresses are chosen by construction first.

b.v: 1-10 scale or H1-H5 (never compared across scales)
b.w: Firmness is matched to the sleeper.
Which?, Consumer Reports, CHOICE and Wirecutter test support, durability and edge support.

b.v: 100+ night trial; 10+ year warranty
b.w: Long trials offset buying unseen.

s.brief: Trim IKEA to 3-4 ranges plus other market leaders. Four-poster: cut 1stdibs SKUs, add canopy/tester bed and half-tester as types, period forms. Add charpai (South Asian woven rope bed, tradition entry) and Murphy/wall bed. Bunk and loft beds: tag baby where child-sized.

k.brief: Types: panel bed, sleigh bed, storage bed, upholstered bed, headboard.
Murphy bed.

s.brief: Tier: cut the IKEA/Tempur SKU list to market-covering brands (Tempur, Sealy, Simmons, Serta, Casper, Emma, Simba, Silentnight, Purple, Saatva, IKEA) plus every brand topping an independent test (Which?, Consumer Reports, CHOICE, Wirecutter). Construction as types. Shikibuton under futon mattress.

All tagged baby. Tier: market-covering makers plus test winners; Tripp Trapp (Stokke) as archetype of the grow-with-child high chair; Pack 'n Play as play-yard archetype. Add changing table. Bed guard rail kept here as a child-safety kind (not a spare part).

depts.note: Tier for flat-pack and everyday cabinets; variety for period, craft and design-classic storage.

b.v: solid wood > veneer on plywood > veneer on particleboard or MDF
b.w: Cabinets are judged by the main material first.

b.v: dovetailed drawers on runners > dowel > cam-lock or staple
b.w: Drawer construction shows build quality.

b.v: wall anchor supplied; meets ASTM F2057 / STURDY Act
b.w: Tip-over safety for chests and wardrobes.

b.v: documented antique > later copy
b.w: Collectors judge by tradition, period and maker.

s.brief: Trim IKEA (PAX, Malm, Hemnes as mass-market icons). New kinds: tansu (Japanese chest; forms: isho-dansu, kaidan-dansu stair chest, choba-dansu, funa-dansu ship chest, kuruma-dansu) and bandaji (Korean chest). Tallboy/highboy and commode as chest-of-drawers types; Shaker chests, Biedermeier, Gustavian painted furniture, cassone and dowry chests via traditions register. Trunk: cut Sierra Living SKUs; steamer trunk archetype (Louis Vuitton, Goyard) if sourced.

k.brief: Armoire, linen press as types.
Types: tallboy, highboy, commode, dresser.
Hope chest, cassone, dowry chest.

s.brief: Trim IKEA (Bestå, Billy, Hemnes). Archetypes: Eames Storage Unit, Florence Knoll credenza, Danish teak sideboards (Hans Wegner, Arne Vodder), Boulle marquetry cabinets, Biedermeier and Gustavian vitrines, Chinese hardwood cabinets (Ming/Qing). Vitrine as alias of display cabinet (curio cabinet, china cabinet). Bar cabinet: cocktail cabinet archetypes. Shoe cabinet: Hemnes/Trones tier.

k.brief: Aliases vitrine, curio, china cabinet.

s.brief: Archetypes: Vitsœ 606 (Dieter Rams), USM Haller, String (Nisse Strinning), Ptolemy, Billy and Ivar as mass-market icons, Kallax. Dissolve 'Other wall shelves', floating shelf, corner shelf and picture ledge into one Wall shelf kind with types. Filing cabinet and locker: restraint (locker kept with no models).

k.brief: Types: floating, corner, picture ledge, bracket shelf.

b.v: solid wood or steel > plastic > cardboard
b.w: Racks and boxes are judged on how much they hold without sagging.

s.brief: Trim IKEA lists to ≤5 ranges per kind plus other market leaders already in data. Merge shoe bag into hanging organiser as a type.

k.brief: Types: shoe bag, over-door organiser, wardrobe shelves.

s.brief: Restraint: trim IKEA lists, plain definitions.

Folding screen archetypes: Japanese byōbu, Chinese Coromandel lacquer screens, Eames Folding Screen (FSW), Damascene and Moroccan mashrabiya screens via traditions register. Room divider: trim IKEA. Desk screen and display stand: restraint (display stand for collections at home only). Plant stand: trim West Elm SKUs.
One entry: bed slats, table legs and replacement shelves become types of a single spare-parts kind.

k.brief: Types: bed slats, table legs, replacement shelves, hinges and fittings.

drop.why: Shop counters and fittings are trade equipment (scope rule).
